about.description: SOLA is an XRPL-issued token representing a beneficial interest in an Alter SPV Investments structure that holds an approximate 1% non-dilutive minority equity stake in PT Solarisia Energi Indonesia. PT Solarisia Energi Indonesia is an Indonesian photovoltaic technology manufacturer producing solar modules and energy infrastructure for commercial, industrial, utility-scale, agricultural, and remote-power applications. SOLA holders do not acquire direct legal ownership of Solarisia shares, and all token-related matters are administered by Alter SPV Investments.
